about: The pre-flight gate: one day of measurements on the host decides whether the platform may be installed at all (ADR 0007, decision 3). Read by `python -m hftlab.ops.preflight`, which runs before anything of ours is installed and so needs nothing but the standard library: that is why this one file is JSON. Sizes are in kB as /proc/meminfo and df count them (1024 bytes). `decided_by: plan` is a number of the approved plan and changes only with a decision record; `decided_by: engineering` is a first choice made in this repository.

headroom_min_kb.source: ADR 0007, decision 3: less than about 1.5 GB of memory available at the other desks' peak means the platform is not installed

disk_floor_kb.source: The other desks' free-disk floor of 3 GB, which this platform may never push them below (ADR 0007, decision 4)

span_min_seconds.source: ADR 0007, decision 3: one day of measurements. Five minutes short of 24 hours is still a day

disk_budget_kb.source: What this platform may take from the disk: the recording quota of config/recorder.yaml, which is still a placeholder, and about 1 GB for the install, the journals and the logs. A test keeps it above that quota

samples_min.source: One sample a minute for a day is 1440. An hour of them, in all, may be missing

gap_max_seconds.source: A hole of more than ten minutes between two samples could hide the other desks' peak

age_max_seconds.source: A measurement more than a week old says little about the host as it is now
